text: A replacement sidebar whose row reads "done" for a stop with no verdict yet, or shows a count other than the hub's, fails `session.row@1` at install, naming the row

A generated test over random event sequences finds exactly one state for every session, the same after a hub restart and after a replay to the same `log_pos`; a session with an open ask and a stale verdict reads needs you on every surface, and a fixture BLOCKED session whose unblock task defaulted reads "BLOCKED · waits for <owner>: <evidence>"; a bare BLOCKED fails, naming the row
A planted group count that includes moot asks fails, naming the group

A session with no task whose first prompt is "fix the flaky checkout test" reads that name in the sidebar, on its page, in its notification and in `deep status`; two sessions with that prompt each add their short ID; on the merge base a surface shows "Session" and an ID, and the test fails, naming the surface

For sessions reading working, quiet, says done and interrupted in a replica fixture, every fact `--why` names exists at its `log_pos`, and recomputing the state from only those facts gives the same word; a planted `--why` built from a separate reading, which says "quiet" for a row the table reads as working, fails, naming the session and the row
Rename from the Session menu puts the caret in the page's title, and Return saves the name to the row and to `deep status`. A planted app with no way to rename fails
